# Ezekiel 28 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 28:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | The word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | Then the LORD gave me this message: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 28:2 (overlap: 14%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "Son-of-man, say to the-ruler-of Tyre: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Because your-heart is-lifted-up and-you-said, 'I [am] a-god; in-the-seat-of gods I-sit, in-the-heart-of the-seas' — yet-you [are] a-man and-not God, though-you-set your-heart as-the-heart-of a-god —" |
| LOGOS | "Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, Thus says the Lord GOD: Because your heart is proud, and you have said, 'I am a god, I sit in the seat of the gods, in the heart of the seas,' yet you are but a man, and no god, though you make your heart like the heart of a god —" |
| PNEUMA | "Son of man, give the ruler of Tyre this message from the Sovereign LORD: In your arrogance you have said, 'I am a god! I sit on a divine throne in the heart of the sea.' But you are only a man, not a god, though you think you are as wise as a god." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 28:13 (overlap: 26%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "In-Eden, the-garden-of God, you-were; every precious stone [was] your-covering: ruby, topaz, and-diamond, beryl, onyx, and-jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and-emerald; and-gold — the-workmanship-of your-settings and-your-engravings in-you — on-the-day you-were-created they-were-prepared." |
| LOGOS | "You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was your covering, sardius, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, emerald, and carbuncle; and crafted in gold were your settings and your engravings. On the day that you were created they were prepared." |
| PNEUMA | "You were in Eden, the garden of God. You were covered with every kind of precious stone — ruby, topaz, diamond, beryl, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and emerald — all set in beautiful gold. They were given to you on the day you were created." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
